---
title: "Summarize groups"
---

Count the orders, total the units, and average the units for each region,
then sort the regions by total.

{{< include pages/_group-and-summarize.md >}}

- `summarize()` after `group_by('region')` returns one row per region.
- `n()` counts every row in the group, including the row whose `units` is
  missing.
- `naRm: true` leaves missing values out of `sum()` and `mean()`. Without it,
  the South total and mean are NA, as in R.
- The summaries evaluate in order, and each can use the ones before it. A
  summary named `units` would replace the `units` column for the mean that
  follows, so the total is named `total_units`.

Reference: [Single-table functions](../reference/single-table.qmd#summaries) ·
[Grouping](../reference/grouping.qmd) ·
